As our friends here have been pointing out, an Age Verification System, by itself, is not enough. The current system only allows individuals with a paid VRChat Plus subscription to create groups, or open group instances. While there are many groups, there are very few large public groups for adults, and even fewer who will open more than one instance. As such, the current environment still leaves most adults, age verified or not, with a lack of public age-gated instance to choose from. This makes "age verification" similar to purchasing a gift certificate with no place to spend it. While an Age Verification System may be a necessary first step in the right direction, it is only the first step. The ADULT CHILL SPOT is an adult group that has been working to resolve this issue with their Hosting Program. The ADULT CHILL SPOT offers non-plus users the opportunity to open group instances. They urge all 18+ age verified VRChat users to join their legion of 5000+ Members, and to assist in expanding their Hosting Program. Opening "Your World, Your Way", as a Host, is expected to bring a variety of gated public instances to the adult virtual landscape. As the ADULT CHILL SPOT Hosting Program expands, it plans to have a multitude of instances opened across the internet at the same time. Combining the Hosting Program to the Age Verification System should bring VRChat a lot closer to what our friends here have been hoping for..  World Optionaity and Age-Verified Security that more closely resembles the idea of VRChat For Adults. Please check out the ADULT CHILL SPOT Group and their Discord for more information!

@{60e65f577ae9d0492b0f2a75|full_name} so you're saying the world creator should have to verify every single time a public instance with a configuration such as 18+ is being created. why?

besides, this doesnt explain why there are no 18+ instances that are friends+, friends, invite+ or invite

@{6852b58916069571f63e6ee8|full_name} no, that's not what i'm saying. No instance creation need to be "verified". Why should the world creator approve your instance creation? The World owner should be able to allow or disallow this type of instance in general.

We had this instances in the beginning. They got disabled by VRChat. Why? idk.

details: I’d like to propose an expansion of the age-gating feature to include other instance types beyond group instances. Not everyone has access to a group they can host events through, nor do some users typically host 18+ events in group instances; these events are usually held in private instances, such as Invite+. Allowing anyone to create an age-gated instance would potentially better serve the community, especially adults who prefer to interact with others in their general age group without needing to rely on group instances.
title: Expand Age-Gating to All Instance Types
